reason: I've never stuck with a budget or a tracker, and I just check my UPI history when money feels tight. I might download the free version after a bad month, but I wouldn't pay for Pro when I don't even know if I'll open it in week two.
objection: Every auto-tracking app I've tried misses or doubles transactions and I end up cleaning up the mess. And linking my bank account to a brand-new app from one solo developer with zero reviews feels risky.
would_change_my_mind: Using the free version for a month and finding it got my spends right without me fixing anything, plus seeing real reviews from people like me.
